root_idea.summary: The root centers on uncovering and becoming manifest, especially through the opening of the face and display of the teeth in laughter.
root_idea.development: From facial opening and the visible teeth of laughter, the lexicon extends metaphorically to brightness, glistening, openness, overflow, and clear or conspicuous appearance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized to the Form I perfect citation form ضَحِكَ.
Form IV causative verb is a distinct Quranic lexical form.
Presented under the masculine active-participial citation form ضَاحِك.
Feminine active participle ضَاحِكَةٌ is an inflectional counterpart of the displayed citation form ضَاحِك.

senses.definition: To laugh; to show happiness or gladness through an expanded face and displayed teeth, and hence to be joyful.
senses.usage_conditions: The ordinary positive use includes both audible or visible laughter and the broader state of gladness. Grammatical person, aspect, and number vary across the Quranic occurrences.

senses.definition: To laugh at, mock, deride, or ridicule someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ or بِـ and in contexts where laughter expresses contempt or derision rather than ordinary amusement.

senses.definition: To express wonder or astonishment through laughter or a laughing reaction.
senses.usage_conditions: This interpretation is especially relevant to the Sarah passage and to contexts pairing laughter with wonder or astonishment.

senses.definition: To menstruate, according to a disputed interpretation of the Sarah passage.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an explicitly reported but contested interpretation of the Quranic occurrence at 11:71; other lexical explanations understand the verb as laughter or wonder.

senses.definition: To be frightened, according to a disputed interpretation of the Sarah passage.
senses.usage_conditions: A minority interpretation reported for the Quranic occurrence at 11:71; it is not the unqualified ordinary meaning of the verb.

senses.definition: To make or cause someone to laugh.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction; the causer may be God or a human agent.

senses.definition: Laughing; showing gladness or a cheerful, smiling expression.
senses.usage_conditions: The masculine and feminine forms are included under one active-participial citation form. Quranic usage can describe visible laughter or the broader appearance of gladness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ape: to utter cries while displaying the teeth or grinning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal use, distinct from the ordinary human act of laughing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of clouds: to lighten, especially by flashing or brightening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the visible manifestation associated with laughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a pool or body of water: to glisten when full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The glistening is associated with fullness and overflowing brightness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the teeth: to glisten or appear through laughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction in which the teeth are treated as displaying the visible sign of laughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of flowers, the earth, or gardens: to display blossoms or put forth vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plant and landscape use describing emergence and conspicuous display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm spathe or the palm fruit cluster: to split or burst open, exposing what is inside.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a hare or hyena: to menstruate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare and disputed animal application reported in the lexical tradition; it is distinct from the contested Quranic interpretation concerning Sarah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a hyena: to bare the teeth, grin, snarl, or rejoice over prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic and animal usage with several reported interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a gum-acacia tree: to exude gum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative botanical expression associated with the emission or disclosure of an inner substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Laughing together, laughing with another, or vying with another in laughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III verbal-noun usage; it may also be extended figuratively to things that vie in brightness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Making sport with ambiguities or treating confused matters as though they were easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction applied to clear or penetrating judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a hyena to bare its teeth, snarl, rejoice, or menstruate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare figurative causative use, variously explained in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a watering trough until it overflows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative causative construction based on the glistening or visible fullness of the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: White front teeth; by extension, an intensely white or bright thing, such as honey, fresh butter, snow, blossoms, or the exposed interior of a palm spadix.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are lexicalized extensions from the whiteness and visible appearance of the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clear, open, conspicuous, or wide road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of openness and conspicuous visibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or choicest things; especially the best possessions or children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural expression, including ضَحْكَاتُ القُلُوبِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or person made an object of laughter or ridicule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet of disapproval for the object at which people laugh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who laughs frequently or habitually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The epithet can carry either commendation or disparagement depending on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cheerful or smiling in countenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person's facial expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of clouds: appearing or extending across the horizon and lightening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active-participial use applied to cloud formations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In reference to a tooth, laughingly displaying the teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression such as ضَاحِكُ السِّنِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very white, conspicuous stone appearing in a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of brightness, regardless of the mountain's overall color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plain, perspicuous judgment that is not confused or dubious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of ضَاحِكٌ for clarity and manifestness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bursting or opening spathes of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use referring to the exposed spathes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tooth located between the canine teeth and molars, especially one visible when laughing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun; its plural is ضَوَاحِكُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The front teeth, literally the place or means of laughter because they appear when one laughs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun used in expressions for the appearance of the front teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A laughable thing, or a thing that causes laughter or ridicule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural of the first sense is أَضَاحِيكُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extraordinary things or sayings that cause laughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural expression for amusing or laughable anecdotes and oddities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect laughter, manifest laughter, or laugh together with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI usage; it may describe affected or reciprocal laughter, including people laughing together.

cautions: The Sarah passage at 11:71 has competing reported interpretations: ordinary laughter, wonder, menstruation, and fright. The latter two are retained as disputed Quranic interpretations rather than presented as unqualified meanings.
A Lane citation in this discussion uses historical citation notation; it has not been converted into a modern verse location independently of the supplied QAC location.
The feminine active participle ضَاحِكَةٌ is merged under the masculine citation form ضَاحِك; its separate anatomical noun meaning 'a tooth' remains distinct under other classical meanings.
